verdict.rationale: Ashby is an ATS with built-in scheduling, so this story applies. However, the evidence pack never documents calendar invites that carry interview kits or scorecards, or automated reminders to submit feedback. Related items do not count toward this story: Slack-based feedback submission, interview-scheduling webhooks, Slack interview channels and the AI Notetaker are adjacent features or developer building blocks.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
